desc: Exact brute-force BFS over ordered pairs (a,b), a≠b — trusted ground truth; gives 3,-1,4 on samples.
Establish feasibility: possible iff G is not a simple path (a degree≥3 vertex or a cycle gives a passing/parking structure); a path graph → -1.
Structural candidate solver: ans = 2d + min(case1 cycle-on-corridor block, case2 parking at an internal corridor vertex with an off-corridor neighbour = +2, case3 endpoint device = 4*(dist+1)).
Produce the standalone SOLVER (stdin→stdout) from the structural formula, with all validator/brute-force code removed; must print 3,-1,4 quickly.
Run a fast brute-force validator (exhaustive N≤5, random N=6,7) against exact config BFS and report every MISMATCH (graph,S,T,brute,struct).

For each mismatch family, reduce to a minimal graph, hand-trace the true optimum, and patch case1/case2/case3 (watch: cycles off-corridor reachable only via bridges from internal vertices, cycles beyond endpoints, blocks containing S/T, multi-block corridors).
Re-run validation until zero mismatches on all enumerable small graphs, then confirm final solver on samples and N,M ≤ 2e5 performance.
